articles.title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics

concepts_taught.name: Collaboration between LLMs and human experts in scientific research

prerequisites.name: Basic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs)

learning_outcomes: Understand how LLMs can contribute to scientific research in theoretical physics
Recognize the potential of LLMs in deriving new mathematical formulas and results
Appreciate the importance of collaboration between LLMs and human experts in verifying and validating scientific findings
strategic_questions: What are the implications of LLMs deriving new results in theoretical physics for the scientific community?
How can we ensure the accuracy and reliability of LLM-generated scientific findings?
What are the potential applications and limitations of using LLMs in scientific research?

prerequisites.name: Basic understanding of natural language processing

learning_outcomes: Understand how to leverage GPT for large-scale social science research
Learn to convert qualitative data into quantitative data using AI tools
Familiarize with the GABRIEL open-source toolkit
strategic_questions: How can social scientists effectively validate the accuracy of AI-generated quantitative data?
What are the potential limitations and biases of using GPT for large-scale research analysis?
How can researchers ensure the responsible use of AI tools in social science research?

learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of real-time coding models
Learn about the importance of context window size in language models
strategic_questions: How will real-time coding models change the way we approach software development?
What are the potential applications of large context window sizes in language models?

articles.title: GPT-5 lowers the cost of cell-free protein synthesis

learning_outcomes: Understand how large language models can be applied to biotechnology
Learn about the potential of autonomous labs in reducing costs
Recognize the role of closed-loop experimentation in optimizing biological processes
strategic_questions: How can large language models be further integrated into biotechnology workflows to drive innovation?
What are the potential limitations and challenges of using autonomous labs in biotechnology?
How might the cost savings from autonomous labs impact the development of new biotechnology products?
